steps.name: Laios
steps.text: *huff*... *huff*...

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: (Humming)

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: I don't see anyone out here in the wilds. How much longer are we gonna have to walk?

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Hey, you're being way too chipper about all this.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: (Humming) That's because I managed to get one of this world's magical items!

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Sure, but it's just some trash no one else wanted.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Hmph, don't tell me you wouldn't be happy-as-can-be if you found a new type of lockpick?

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Ever since coming to this world, I've found it difficult to use my own magic. Instead, there is a unknown form of magic here that I can't use.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: But now, I have this D32 Steel flashlight!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: The factory owner said this 'D32 Steel' can withstand incredible amounts of energy, and that local mages use it to make magical items. Maybe I could use it to channel my magic better!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: I even saw him use it to fire off something like a flash spell!

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: I still believe that nothing in this world comes without a price.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Maybe he didn't want to let a perfectly good tool go to waste, so he gave it to an amazing mage like me, heh heh.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: I'm so hyped up about the principles behind this world's magic now.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Well, why not get in some practice? How about using it to get the fruit down from that tree over there?

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: It's rare to see fruit trees here, and there's a few by the water. We might not get another chance.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: You just want to taste the fruit...

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: But fine. Just for practice. I'll give it a go.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Hmm...

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Hyah...!
A moment of silence.

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Nothing's happening.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: B-But how?! The factory man could use it just fine, and I can feel it responding to me!

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Maybe you're imagining things.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Hmph! I'll give it another go!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Grrrrrrhhhhhhhh...!
Yet another moment of silence.

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Still nothing.

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Can you really get this 'flashlight' thing to work, Marcille?

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Why not go back to using your staff?

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: I just need to get used to it! Give me a moment and I'll understand how it works.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: *Deep breath*

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Hyah!

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Oh! You did it!

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Marcille, I knew you could—eh?

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Why'd you blow yourself up?

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: *cough* *cough* *cough* *cough*!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: *cough* *cough* *cough* *cough*! *cough* *cough* *cough* *cough*!

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Look, no need to push yourself...

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Why... Why does magic come out of the end?!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Why are this world's magic items so hard to use?

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: This is why I hate magic.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: That's different! *cough* *cough* *cough*!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: One more time! This time I'll get it right, for sure!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Excuse me! I think this D32 flashlight has some issues—

steps.name: Factory Owner
steps.text: No way! I gave you my most prized flashlight for free, and now you're back looking for trouble?

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Ahem... No, I'm not! I just want to ask if you happen to sell any books that explain how it works? I'd like to study it if I could...

steps.name: Factory Owner
steps.text: No. What kind of place do you think we are? We're a factory on its last legs. We don't have anything but the weapons and mining machines!

spans.text: No. What kind of place do you think we are? We're a factory on its last legs. We don't have
but the weapons and mining machines!

steps.name: Factory Owner
steps.text: If you don't want it, then give it back! Hmph. I knew it. No one can truly understand the beauty of it. You can even use it to light up the entire night sky!

steps.name: Factory Owner
steps.text: Nobody appreciates this sort of handy gadget... They don't sell at all... And now my factory's about to go out of business... I thought I finally met someone with good taste...

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: I-I didn't mean it that way! It's fine, it's fine, I'll just give it another shot once I've done more research on this world's magical principles! Uh, I mean... Thank you for the gift!

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: We should get back to our search for Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: *sigh* Into that wasteland again? This world's way too big. We'll die of exhaustion before we walk there.

spans.text: *sigh* Into that wasteland again? This world's way too big. We'll die of exhaustion before we

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Hmm... I don't think I've seen any carriages, but...

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Excuse me, this, uh...

steps.name: Factory Owner
steps.text: Truck?

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Oh, so it's called a 'truck'... How much does one cost?

steps.name: Factory Owner
steps.text: Hah! My factory might be going bust, but this truck's still worth a pretty penny. I don't think you could afford one.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Oh.

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: I really doubt we could reach Rhodes Island by walking all the way there...

steps.name: Worker A
steps.text: Here, boss. Lunch.

steps.name: Worker B
steps.text: Boss, we're nearly bankrupt. You should sell whatever we have left, otherwise I'm worried about us getting our wages.

steps.name: Worker B
steps.text: We've been eating carrot rice balls for yonks now! You said we'd have roast golden carrots for our farewell party today, to strive for a better tomorrow!

steps.name: Factory Owner
steps.text: Look, I know I need money to feed you guys, but if I sell off that truck, I'll have nothing to my name!

steps.name: Factory Owner
steps.text: Alright, you all, we're about to start prepping for our party, so I'll leave you to your business.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: A farewell party?

steps.name: Worker A
steps.text: *sigh* It's not like there's anything to prep. All we have are carrots and rice.

spans.text: prep. All we have are carrots and rice.

steps.name: Worker B
steps.text: The very first meal we had when this place opened was golden carrots...

steps.name: Factory Owner
steps.text: *sigh*...

steps.name: Factory Owner
steps.text: If I had any golden carrots to give you, I'd give them. But right now...

steps.name: Factory Owner
steps.text: If I could, I'd love to continue the tradition. If I could.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: So it's a tradition for you to eat golden carrots here?

steps.name: Worker A
steps.text: Yep.

steps.name: Worker A
steps.text: We'd always have a golden carrot dish for our get-together meals.

steps.name: Worker B
steps.text: But looks like we have to give up on the idea today. Seriously, where are we gonna find any? I suppose barbecue and carrot rice will have to do for the party.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Mind if I have a look at your ingredients?

steps.name: Worker A
steps.text: Just this basket of carrots and that meat over there.

steps.name: Worker B
steps.text: What're you doing?

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: I understand the situation here now.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Leave the ingredients to me, will ya?

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: When I'm done cooking, you'll be able to say your goodbyes with a smile.

steps.name: Factory Owner
steps.text: You...

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: (Whispers) What's on his mind?

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: (Whispers) Did you forget? Senshi joined us because he couldn't stand watching Laios cook.

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: (Whispers) He doesn't like seeing other people have sloppy meals.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Eating's not just for survival. It's got emotional value, too. I know how you must be feeling right now.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: I'll help you get some of those golden carrots.

steps.name: Worker A
steps.text: R-Really?

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: You've got plenty of regular carrots, and I can certainly do something with those. But what's a golden carrot exactly?

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Is it just... a gold-colored carrot?

steps.name: Worker A
steps.text: You lot aren't Rim Billitonians, are you?

steps.name: Worker A
steps.text: Golden carrots are a traditional delicacy around these parts. Ore and carrots, Rim Billiton's two specialties!

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: You eat ore? How do you cook it?

steps.name: Worker B
steps.text: Eat ore? No no no! The gold dust on golden carrots comes from the secretions of Goldglitter Originium slugs. That kinda thing is just outta our price range.

steps.name: Worker B
steps.text: But if you could find some Goldglitters, we'd be able to make some right now, no problem.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: I see.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Where do these slugs live?

steps.name: Worker A
steps.text: In mines, out in the wilds, anywhere there's not a lot of people.

steps.name: Worker A
steps.text: See that pit over there? Definitely got a slug nest in it, and the mine there's got two more. That tunnel further ahead is overgrown with grass, which means it's already abandoned by the slugs.

steps.name: Worker A
steps.text: Most of the local Goldglitters get snatched up by trappers, though. Bet it'd be hard to find one.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Huh...

steps.name: Worker A
steps.text: Well, the factory might be shutting down, but I still haven't finished all my work for the day. If you lot can find some Goldglitters, we'd never forget!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: (Whispers) I am a bit hungry, but we should do something about getting to Rhodes Island, right?

spans.text: a bit hungry, but we should do something about getting to Rhodes Island, right?

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: If we do manage to get these golden carrots, would you mind selling us your truck at a discount?

steps.name: Factory Owner
steps.text: I... I'll consider it.

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: There must be slugs around here. I can hear them crawling around!

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Whoa... There's loads of them!

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: How're we supposed to find a Goldglitter in this crowd?

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Only Big Bob can calm them down. We've seen it, their attacks hurt like heck, so I don't think it'll be easy to get their secretions or whatever...

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Looks like we've got no choice but to fight.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Understood.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Stand back! I'll try using the magic item again. I'm definitely getting it right this time!
Marcille lifts the D32 flashlight, shuts her eyes tight, and tries her best to sense the energy stored within.

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: She blew herself up last time. Can she really make it work?

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: No, stop!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: —What is it now?!
Senshi's interruption does nothing to stop the flashlight. In fact, it begins to grow even brighter.

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: Don't kill them all at once, Marcille! You have to take them out one by one—

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: I think we've got a bigger problem than that now, Senshi.

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Marcille's thingy looks like it's about to—
Marcille begins to glow with a dazzling light, her hair fluttering with power.

steps.name: Laios & Chilchuck
steps.text: Gah! My eyes!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Wha-What's happening?!

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: I think the slugs noticed us!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: I see them... B-But I still can't control this thingy very well...

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: Calm down, Marcille. Try it again. It might work.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: Feel the flow of mana being drawn in from all around. Channel that power through my fingertips and into the tool, then release—
Studying and using magic requires one to surpass their limits of focus, preciseness, and sincerity, over and over again.
But what one truly requires is an understanding, acceptance, and awareness of the philosophy of magic!
Right at this moment, Marcille's curiosity for the magic of this world has allowed her to create a miracle—

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: It worked?!

steps.name: Laios
steps.text: It worked... right?

steps.name: Originium Slugs
steps.text: (Cautiously stop)

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: I'm not too sure. It's like I managed to release something, but it disappeared.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: But I can still sense it... Stay on your toes!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: It's going to be a lot more violent than I expected!

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: IT'S ABOUT TO EXPLODE!
They run behind a rock, huddling tight as they cower behind it, praying that it will hold against the blast.
After an eternity of waiting, a foreboding sound begins to rise from beneath the ground.
The earth creaks and groans.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: What kind of sound was that...?

steps.name: Originium Slugs
steps.text: (Carefully back away)

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: I don't think any of those are Goldglitter slugs, though.

steps.name: Marcille
steps.text: How about we get out of here first and look someplace else?

steps.name: Senshi
steps.text: I feel like the soil's loosened up a bit.

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: Yeah, I also heard something break beneath us. Could it be Marcille's magic that went below our fee—

steps.name: Chilchuck
steps.text: —eeetAHHHHHHHHH—
